name: What types of shower enclosures can I choose from for my bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: What types of shower enclosures can I choose from for my bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hometelligent Inc. offers a variety of shower enclosure options to suit different bathroom layouts and styles, including framed, frameless, and semi-frameless designs. The choice often depends on your aesthetic preference, budget, and the existing structure of your bathroom. Frameless enclosures provide a minimalist look, while framed options offer more structural support. We can help assess your space in areas like Berkeley or Alameda to recommend the best fit.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can choose from framed, frameless, and semi-frameless shower enclosures, depending on your style, budget, and bathroom structure.
